queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_val
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration <> 0
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_val AS avg_rate_per_day,
       avg_val - (SELECT AVG(avg_val) FROM r) AS diff_from_overall_mean
FROM r
WHERE avg_val > (SELECT AVG(avg_val) FROM r);
SELECT rating, SUM(rental_rate) / SUM(rental_duration) AS ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS films, AVG(rental_rate), AVG(length), AVG(replacement_cost)
FROM film
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY CASE rating WHEN 'G' THEN 1 WHEN 'PG' THEN 2 WHEN 'PG-13' THEN 3 WHEN 'R' THEN 4 WHEN 'NC-17' THEN 5 END;
